faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bilaspur Junior Resident (Non-Academic) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AIIMS Bilaspur Junior Resident (Non-Academic) posts is 16th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) position at AIIMS Bilaspur in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree or equivalent registered with the Medical Council. For Dentistry, a valid BDS degree and registration with the Dental Council of India is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 56,100/- along with usual allowances as per the AIIMS Bilaspur norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 1180. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Examination, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) positions at AIIMS Bilaspur are offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of AIIMS Bilaspur?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bilaspur is located in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh, with the pincode 174037.
